name: @oxframe/player
description: <oxframe-player>: plays a scene compiled to wasm on any web page. Built to apps/site/static/player.js and player-worker.js.

scripts.build: bun build src/element.ts --outdir ../../apps/site/static --entry-naming player.js --target browser --format esm --minify && bun build ../backends/src/player-worker.ts --outdir ../../apps/site/static --entry-naming player-worker.js --target browser --format esm --minify
